metadata.task: If the water bottle is on the dining table, place it inside the refrigerator; otherwise leave it on the counter.

plan.goal: Locate the water bottle, determine its position (dining table vs. elsewhere), and if found on the dining table, transport it to the refrigerator. If not on the dining table, do nothing.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Locate the water bottle and determine its current position relative to the dining table.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at an initial location (e.g., Main Entrance). Water bottle location is unknown.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has identified the location of the water bottle and determined if it is on the dining table.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot needs to move to the Living Room where the Dining Table is located.
Robot needs to perceive the water bottle to confirm its existence and location.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Verify the water bottle is on the dining table and navigate to the refrigerator.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot knows the water bottle is on the dining table.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has navigated to the refrigerator.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot needs to move from the Living Room to the Kitchen to access the refrigerator.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Pick up the water bottle from the dining table.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the refrigerator with the water bottle on the dining table.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the water bottle.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot needs to grasp the water bottle to transport it.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the water bottle inside the refrigerator.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the water bottle at the refrigerator.
checkpoints.exit_state: Water bottle is inside the refrigerator.

actions.action: Place the water bottle inside the refrigerator.

grounded_skills.reason: Robot needs to open the refrigerator door to insert the bottle.
Robot needs to place the water bottle inside the refrigerator.
Robot needs to close the refrigerator door after placing the bottle.

constraints: Robot can only manipulate one object at a time (single arm).
